summary: Scope matches the Story exactly (test-only, src/ untouched, 4 waits widened, unrelated waitFor sites correctly untouched), but the fix's own AC3 is contradicted under observed load: two targeted runs failed the process-group containment test with a 62.6s condition timeout on the new 60000ms deadline (host load 120-155), while the isolated --test-name-pattern run passed in 3s. No current-head verify-run evidence exists yet for AC3/S-003.

findings.detail: AC3/S-003 require targeted and full-suite passes verified by current-head evidence; none recorded, and two targeted runs reproducibly failed at the 60000ms deadline (62.6s) under load average 120-155.

The Story's 'escalation ceiling ~7.5s plus margin' framing under-sizes the deadline for real multi-worktree load; either widen further or record the load conditions under which verification was captured.
